focus: Rank other .skilled surfaces where a deterministic extractor misses and the same typed fallback would pay off.
noveltyJustification: First ranked cross-surface map with seam citations: reviewer grader slot, residue-flagger skipped rows, deliverable low-confidence path, deterministic sub-scorers, and a considered refusal for runtime completion detection.
keyQuestions: What drove the measured Jev result?
How can accuracy improve or cost fall?
How can the measurement become more trustworthy?
Where else in .skilled would the same judgment pay off?

answeredQuestions: Where else in .skilled would the same judgment pay off?
ruledOut: Treating already-measured 047 features as transfer answers: their verdicts show where the judgment was tested, not where the shape remains available.
Replacing the artifact-based completion check with a model read: self-report unreliability is why the artifact check exists.
focusTrackReason: With result, cost and trust understood, the transfer question asks where the same measured shape applies next.

title: The direct production home is the reviewer grader slot
claim: classifyWithGrader fires exactly on a regex miss under --grader llm; a jev grader value reuses the same question, keys, and measured keep, with enablement behind SPECKIT_REVIEWER_BENCHMARKS and feature 025 D5 gating the wiring.

title: The residue flagger emits its own miss list
claim: The review report table parser keeps only rows with exact P0/P1/P2 severity cells and records unrecognized tables as skipped; a severity fallback has a ready-made corpus source, and deep-review's verdict ladder inherits whatever the parser missed.

title: The deliverable extractor has an explicit low-confidence fall-through
claim: Without DELIVERABLE tags or fences the extractor returns the whole transcript at low confidence and run-benchmark either scores reasoning or fails the fixture; a region judgment would fill that path at the same seam.

title: Two more sub-scorers carry the shape, one Jev-validated
claim: preplanning-regex scores zero when no pre-plan block exists; hallucination-flag pairs an allowlist extractor with a semantic grader and the 024 Jev measurement kept at A=55 B=47, so integration rather than proof is what remains there.

title: Runtime completion detection is a deliberate non-candidate
claim: fanout-run reads self-reported stopReason and falls back to on-disk artifacts when it is missing or unrecognized; a model read of the narrative would reintroduce the self-report trust the artifact check exists to bypass.

title: The reusable assets are the discipline, not the transport
claim: The label gate, frozen keep rule, option rotation, call log and run-directory convention all transfer; each new candidate's expensive part is its own labeled miss corpus, which argues for one shared fallback harness across typed questions.
